decisions.reason: A hearty bread loaf is a low-cost addition to the core bread range that fits existing production, so keeping the option open costs little even though there is no performance evidence.
The sweet pastry uses existing craft skills and equipment, so its holding cost is minimal, and with no negative signal there is no reason to abandon it yet.
A crusty farmhouse bread fits the heritage and regional positioning and is cheap to keep in the assortment while its value remains uncertain.
The poppy seed stollen won a gold award and is presented as a flagship, so its value has largely been revealed and justifies further commitment rather than abandonment.
The premium stollen's gold award signals realized quality and seasonal gift value, and producing it alongside the other stollen costs little, so keeping it is clearly warranted.
